title: SR 26-2 Monitoring Bundle Assembler
description: Recomputes execution_hash from operator-supplied AINumbers receipt JSON files via the shared canonicalizer, reports PASS or FAIL per receipt, and assembles the verified and failed set into a dated SR 26-2 ongoing-monitoring receipt bundle (JSON and Markdown). Never trusts a receipt's own claimed execution_hash.

receipts.description: One or more previously-exported AINumbers receipt JSON files, supplied via file upload

mcp_tool_definition.name: assemble_sr262_monitoring_bundle
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recompute execution_hash from one or more supplied AINumbers receipt JSON objects and assemble the verified and failed set into a dated SR 26-2 ongoing-monitoring receipt bundle. Never trusts a receipt's own claimed execution_hash, always re-derives it from policy_parameters and output_payload. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

receipts.description: Receipt JSON objects, each with policy_parameters, output_payload, and execution_hash
